violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Other Chemical Proper Use
violations.observation: The operator is using a lactic acid sanitizer. Solution was not at acceptable level.
violations.corrective_action: If a chemical sanitizer other than chlorine, iodine, or quaternary ammonium compound is used it shall be applied in accordance with the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling. SANITIZER LINE WILL BE SERVICED.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: food contact equipment stored in a tray with standing water on the shelf across from the 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. EQUIPMENT PULLED FOR PROPER CLEANING AND SANITIZING.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor under ice machine, 3 comp sink and area next to sink is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
